rationale.text: No link and candidate none. The test applies to each bitmap image (<canvas>) that carries information and has a detailed description, and asks that the description be relevant. The wording says the image must meet these conditions, all of them; each condition names one means of giving a description, so each is a requirement that holds when its description is relevant and has nothing to check when the image does not use that means. Relevance is judgment: whether a text describes all the information an image conveys cannot be decided by code. The scope is judgment too, since whether an image carries information is judgment. No axe-core rule is tagged for this test, and none examines the content of descriptions. Applicability is judgment, for the same reason. Needs is state: a description reached through an adjacent button is often shown only once the button is activated, and its content must be seen to be judged.
